name: claude-kb
description: Local full-text search over your past Claude chats and project docs (reads the external claude_kb.db read-only).
long_description: A local, read-only search index over every Claude chat and project doc you have exported. The bundled entry point runs a stdio MCP server exposing kb_search and kb_get_conversation. It queries {{DB_PATH}} by absolute path, so re-indexing (python claude_kb.py update) refreshes results with no extension rebuild.

tools.name: kb_search
tools.description: Full-text search across your past Claude chats and project docs. Returns ranked hits with title, date, sender, source, conversation_uuid, and a highlighted snippet.

tools.name: kb_get_conversation
tools.description: Return all indexed messages for a conversation_uuid, in order (sender + text), to read a full chat after finding it via kb_search.
